# ZBBZ for Autocad_Mac

Commands:

- `ZBBZCONFIG`: open settings.
- `ZBBZ`: start coordinate annotation.

命令：

- `ZBBZCONFIG`：打开设置面板。
- `ZBBZ`：开始坐标标注。

Install by copying `ZBBZ.bundle` to:

```text
~/Library/Application Support/Autodesk/ApplicationAddins
/Applications/Autodesk/ApplicationAddins
```

安装时请把 `ZBBZ.bundle` 复制到：

```text
~/Library/Application Support/Autodesk/ApplicationAddins
/Applications/Autodesk/ApplicationAddins
```
